import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class ModInt {
        private static final long MD = 1000000007L;
        private long v;

        public ModInt(long val) {
            val %= MD;
            if (val < 0) val += MD;
            v = val;
        }

        public ModInt() {
            v = 0;
        }

        public ModInt setV(long val) {
            val %= MD;
            if (val < 0) val += MD;
            v = val;
            return this;
        }

        public ModInt setV(long val, long md) {
            val %= md;
            if (val < 0) val += md;
            v = val;
            return this;
        }

        public boolean equals(ModInt other) {
            return v == other.v;
        }

        public ModInt neg() {
            return new ModInt().setV(-v);
        }

        public ModInt add(ModInt r) {
            return new ModInt().setV(v + r.v);
        }

        public ModInt sub(ModInt r) {
            return new ModInt().setV(v + MD - r.v);
        }

        public ModInt mul(ModInt r) {
            return new ModInt().setV((v * r.v) % MD);
        }

        public ModInt div(ModInt r) {
            return mul(r.inv());
        }

        public ModInt addSelf(ModInt r) {
            return setV(v + r.v);
        }

        public ModInt subSelf(ModInt r) {
            return setV(v + MD - r.v);
        }

        public ModInt mulSelf(ModInt r) {
            return setV((v * r.v) % MD);
        }

        public ModInt divSelf(ModInt r) {
            return mul(r.inv());
        }

        public ModInt pow(long n) {
            ModInt x = new ModInt().setV(v);
            ModInt r = new ModInt(1);
            while (n > 0) {
                if ((n & 1) == 1) {
                    r = r.mul(x);
                }
                x = x.mul(x);
                n >>= 1;
            }
            return r;
        }

        public ModInt inv() {
            return pow(MD - 2);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(v);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        ModInt[][] mat = new ModInt[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                mat[i][j] = new ModInt(x).div(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        List<State> sts = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> initList = new ArrayList<>();
        initList.add(0);
        sts.add(new State(initList, new ModInt(1)));

        for (int ph = 0; ph < n; ph++) {
            List<State> nsts = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int f = 1; f < (1 << n); f++) {
                ModInt freq = new ModInt(1);
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (((f >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                        freq = freq.mul(mat[ph][i]);
                    } else {
                        freq = freq.mul(new ModInt(1).sub(mat[ph][i]));
                    }
                }

                for (State st : sts) {
                    List<Integer> nst = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int d : st.indices) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                            if (((d >> i) & 1) == 1) continue;
                            if (((f >> i) & 1) == 0) continue;
                            nst.add(d ^ (1 << i));
                        }
                    }
                    if (nst.isEmpty()) continue;
                    Collections.sort(nst);
                    List<Integer> uniqueList = new ArrayList<>();
                    Integer prev = null;
                    for (int val : nst) {
                        if (prev == null || prev != val) {
                            uniqueList.add(val);
                            prev = val;
                        }
                    }
                    nsts.add(new State(uniqueList, st.prob.mul(freq)));
                }
            }

            Collections.sort(nsts, (a, b) -> {
                if (a.indices.size() != b.indices.size()) {
                    return Integer.compare(a.indices.size(), b.indices.size());
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < a.indices.size(); i++) {
                    if (!a.indices.get(i).equals(b.indices.get(i))) {
                        return Integer.compare(a.indices.get(i), b.indices.get(i));
                    }
                }
                return 0;
            });

            sts.clear();
            for (State st : nsts) {
                if (!sts.isEmpty() && sts.get(sts.size() - 1).indices.equals(st.indices)) {
                    State last = sts.get(sts.size() - 1);
                    last.prob = last.prob.add(st.prob);
                } else {
                    sts.add(new State(new ArrayList<>(st.indices), st.prob));
                }
            }
        }

        ModInt ans = new ModInt(0);
        if (!sts.isEmpty()) {
            ans = sts.get(0).prob;
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static class State {
        List<Integer> indices;
        ModInt prob;

        State(List<Integer> indices, ModInt prob) {
            this.indices = indices;
            this.prob = prob;
        }
    }
}
